summary: Lifeway Foods filed an 8-K announcing its board authorized the redemption of preferred share purchase rights under the Shareholder Rights Agreement dated November 4, 2024, as amended, effective June 5, 2026. The rights are redeemed at $0.001 per Right, terminating the Rights Agreement and all outstanding rights. This is a routine redemption of a shareholder rights plan (poison pill) with no special-situation event such as an acquisition, tender offer, or activist campaign. The filing only amends security holder rights and terminates a material definitive agreement, thus does not qualify as a special situation.
